title: Home guide: the drip test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials and how they change (Muck, Mess & Mixtures and Will It Degrade?)
source: Written for science/y2 lesson 6 (Home practical guide and safety card: testing properties (portal worksheet); work on a tray, wipe spills)
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which materials soak up water and which make it run off.
equipment: Kitchen roll, foil, a sponge, a plastic bag (an adult holds it)
safety: Work on a tray; wipe spills
Keep plastic bags away from faces
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put the first material on the tray.
Drip one teaspoon of water onto it.
Watch: does the water soak in or run off?
Do the same for each material.
